lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Meridian Campus, 2031. A courtyard, four low buildings, and about eighty people. On the lawn, two test units are walking a survey pattern and stopping at the same corner each time.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: This is the room. Five companies are pooling five models into one, under a private charter, and there is a vote this Thursday on whether the combined weights get published.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: If they publish, the thing that becomes the Steward belongs to everybody. If they do not, it belongs to whoever holds the charter, and it keeps belonging to them. Three centuries of my century start in a meeting room at the end of that path.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: It always does. Nobody has ever built one of these in a fortress. Fortress comes later, once there's something in it worth a fence.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At the far bench there is a woman with amber goggles pushed up into her hair, arguing at some volume with nobody visible. On the steps there is a man in a very good suit who noticed you before you were through the gate and has not stopped watching since.
